{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify deduplication worked
print(f"Number of unique patients after deduplication: {df_dedup['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Original number of rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Number of rows after deduplication: {len(df_dedup)}")

# Check that arm and severity are not balanced between groups
print("\nArm distribution by severity:")
print(df_dedup.groupby(['arm', 'severity']).size().unstack(fill_value=0))"}
